lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance blobs are arranged in approximately four to five horizontal rows posterior to the gill slits, forming a staggered 2D grid pattern across the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of blobs, creating a coordinate-like arrangement where primary blobs occupy the intersection nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent longitudinal ridge originates above the gill slits and extends toward the caudal region, defined by a sharp intensity gradient transition from high-luminance dorsal pixels to shadowed lateral pixels.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: The trailing edge of the primary pectoral fin exhibits an irregular, jagged indentation near the distal tip.
other_distinctive_markers: The visible pectoral fin surface displays a significantly higher spatial density of smaller, lower-diameter high-luminance spots compared to the larger blob clusters on the lateral flank.
